437:## Security
438-
439-The action only responds to authorized users (see [`src/security.ts`](src/security.ts)):
440-- Repository owners and organization members by default (`allowed_associations: OWNER,MEMBER`)
441-- Explicit usernames in `allowed_users`, when configured
442-- Bots explicitly added to `allowed_bots`
443-
444-Collaborators are not allowed by default. Add `COLLABORATOR` to `allowed_associations` if you want outside collaborators to trigger pi.
445-
446-The agent's tools get `github_token` as `GH_TOKEN` and a `github-actions[bot]` git identity when the workflow sets neither (see [the agent's GitHub token and git identity](#the-agents-github-token-and-git-identity)), so the token's permissions are the agent's. pi extensions loaded with `extensions` run with the job's permissions; see [Providers from pi extensions](#providers-from-pi-extensions). For pi-durable extensions, keep `trust_project` off unless you trust everyone who can change the repository, and see [Questions on GitHub](#questions-on-github) for who can answer their questions.
447-
448-Input is sanitized to remove:
449-- HTML comments (potential injection vectors)
450-- Invisible Unicode characters
451-
